name: William Hubert Ferber — ancestral origins & death
researcher_question: What are the ancestral origins and details surrounding the death of William Hubert Ferber (father of Charles Hubert Ferber, b. 1891, Cincinnati, Ohio)?
notes: Compound objective spanning ancestral origins (parents) and death details. Subject William Hubert Ferber (b. Dec 1869 Ohio, d. 11 Mar 1903 Cincinnati), anchored via his son Charles Hubert Ferber (b. 1891). Parents Gerhard Ferber (b. 1820 Germany, immigrated ~1849-1850, naturalized 1853 Ohio) and Eva Engermann (b. 1834 Bavaria) are strongly corroborated: the 1870 census lists both in the household, and William's own 1903 Ohio death record separately names Gerhard as father. Death 11 Mar 1903 Cincinnati is on the Ohio death record; burial at Spring Grove Cemetery, Cincinnati, per Find a Grave and the cemetery index. The kept 1900 census leaves a legitimate German-origin breadcrumb (parents' birthplace) without naming the parents.
